floor_note: CONTRACTS.md calls 0.60 the most arguable constant in the project. Two results sit within two points of it, in opposite directions: Garmin passes at 0.609 and YETI fails at 0.581. Neither should be read as a clean call.
method: Each company's own latest 10-K, via EDGAR's rendered R-files indexed in FilingSummary.xml. Figures are quoted with the R-file URL they came from. Where a filing's tagged notes do not split revenue the way the measured products require, share_of_revenue is left null rather than estimated.
what_the_failures_have_in_common: Four of the five failures are companies whose reviewable consumer product is NOT the bulk of the business: Toro sells to golf courses and grounds crews, Peloton sells subscriptions, Cricut sells a subscription platform, Spectrum sells pet and garden products under other brands. Review tone on the consumer item cannot speak for revenue it does not drive. This is confound 3 in prereg/panel-tone-v2.md, and it removed the two largest contributors to the panel.
new_concentration_risk: BowFlex is now 47 of 203 surviving quarters (23%), and its revenue series ends 2023Q4 because of the Chapter 11. Leave-one-company-out matters more after this gate than before it.
